name: Build A Rocket
desc:
🚀 Welcome to Build A Rocket! 🚀
Redeem code MONEY for free rewards!

Build what you imagine, weave through challenging obstacles, and discover infinite procedural biomes! 🌌

🛠️ Check the shop restock for new blocks to build your dream rocket! 
💥 Dodge dangerous obstacles, and discover interesting biomes!
🎯 Launch to get rich, and buy even more upgrades!
⚡ Discover all the unique blocks, can you earn them all?

⏰ AND IT REALLY FLIES OFFLINE 🤑
